meta.title: Fabric library — Thiên Canh
meta.description: An album of the silks, brocades, raw silks and linens at Thiên Canh: origin, fibre content, drape, weight, best seasons and how to care for each.

title: An album of the fabrics in our atelier
subtitle: Every fabric here has passed through a tailor’s hands: felt, held up to the sun, draped before it ever becomes an áo dài. Turn the pages to find the one that suits your figure and your season.
